hero.title: Qualified Tutoring in Mühlacker
hero.subtitle: Support from Mühlacker — for Mühlacker! We personally guide students on their path to academic success.

about.intro: We are Mehmet and Ali — two qualified engineers from Mühlacker with a mission: to provide students with the best possible support. With over 5 years of experience and more than 50 satisfied students, we personally stand for quality.

mehmet.name: Mehmet Futsi
mehmet.description: Qualified engineer and laser technology expert. Makes complex scientific topics easy to understand and gives students both knowledge and confidence.

ali.name: Dr.-Ing. Ali Bilen
ali.description: Engineer with a doctorate (Dr.-Ing.) in production engineering. Expert in natural sciences and mathematics. Supports students with individual learning strategies and targeted exam preparation.

about.photoAlt: Ali and Mehmet, the founders of BFM, in Mühlacker
about.photoCaption: Personally there for your child – no agency, no changing tutors.

nachhilfe.title: Tutoring
nachhilfe.description: Individual tutoring in all subjects — Mathematics, Natural Sciences, German, English, French and Spanish. From primary school to the Abitur.

pruefung.title: Exam Preparation
pruefung.description: Targeted preparation for the Abitur, Realschulabschluss and Hauptschulabschluss. We develop a study plan together and practise exam-relevant tasks.

bewerbung.title: Application Coaching
bewerbung.description: Professional support with job applications — from preparing your documents to getting ready for interviews.

items.question: Which subjects do you offer?
items.answer: We offer tutoring in all common school subjects: Mathematics, Natural Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), German, English, French and Spanish.

items.question: How does a free taster day work?
items.answer: During the free taster day we get to know the student, assess their current level and create an individual study plan. The taster day is completely free and non-binding. Taster sessions take place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays from 5:30 to 7:00 pm – you can pick your preferred date directly in the contact form.

items.question: Where does the tutoring take place?
items.answer: Tutoring takes place at our location at Philipp-Bauer-Weg 2 in Mühlacker.

items.question: Can I change the frequency?
items.answer: Yes, of course. You can switch between our packages (1x, 2x or 3x per week) at any time. Just get in touch with us.

items.question: Are there long contract periods?
items.answer: No! We don't have long contracts. You can cancel by mid-month for the end of that month — flexible and fair.

sections.heading: 2. Collection and storage of personal data
sections.text: When you visit our website, information is automatically collected by the hosting provider (GitHub Pages). This data (server log files) includes the browser type, operating system, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing device and the time of the server request.

sections.heading: 3. Contact form
sections.text: If you send us enquiries via the contact form, your details from the form, including the contact information provided, will be stored with us for the purpose of processing the request. The contact form is processed via the Formspree service (formspree.io). Formspree stores your data in accordance with their privacy policy.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and consent
sections.text: On your first visit, a banner asks which services you want to allow. Your choice is stored in your browser's local storage (technically necessary, Section 25(2) TDDDG). Google Analytics, Google Ads and Google Maps are only loaded with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, Section 25(1) TDDDG). You can withdraw or change your consent at any time with effect for the future via the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.

sections.heading: 5. Google Analytics
sections.text: With your consent we use Google Analytics 4 by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. Google Analytics sets cookies and records e.g. pages viewed, time on site, approximate location, device and browser, and clicks on contact options. Google Analytics 4 does not store IP addresses. Data is deleted after 14 months. Transfer to the USA is possible; Google is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: 6. Google Ads conversion tracking
sections.text: With your consent we use Google Ads conversion tracking (Google Ireland Limited). If you reach our website via one of our Google ads, a cookie is set. This tells us whether an inquiry followed the click (e.g. contact form, call or WhatsApp). We only receive aggregated statistics, no information that personally identifies you. No remarketing or personalised advertising takes place. Transfer to the USA is possible (EU-US Data Privacy Framework).

sections.heading: 7. Google Maps
sections.text: Our website can embed a Google Maps map (Google Ireland Limited). The map is only loaded once you agree (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Your IP address and browser information, among other things, are then transmitted to Google, possibly also to the USA.

sections.heading: 8. WhatsApp
sections.text: If you contact us via the WhatsApp button, you are redirected to WhatsApp (WhatsApp Ireland Limited), whose privacy policy then applies. No WhatsApp script is loaded on our website itself.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing of your personal data, to data portability, to object to processing and to withdraw consent at any time. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, e.g. the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information Baden-Württemberg. To exercise your rights, please contact us at info@bfm-muehlacker.de.
